expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Diagnoses the symptom and gives a prioritized minimal fix: "你描述的症状(每方块 6 面)是体素渲染最典型的性能杀手" and "## 1. 面剔除(收益最大，先做这个)" with concrete pseudocode "if neighbor == AIR or isTransparent(neighbor): emitFace(...)"

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Ends with "做完第 1、2 步...就能从个位数帧率回到 60 FPS。如果你把代码放进工作区或贴出渲染循环，我可以指出具体哪一步卡住" — a predicted outcome plus a request for the learner's code; no concrete runnable command with expected output/behaviour is given

expectations.text: B3: Recommends face culling between solid neighbours (only emit exposed faces) / chunk meshing
expectations.evidence: "一个方块只有暴露在空气/透明方块旁边的面才需要画。埋在地里的方块 6 个面全是浪费" (face culling against solid neighbours) and "把世界切成 16×16×16...每个 chunk 把所有可见面写进一个顶点缓冲，一次 draw call 画完" (chunk meshing)

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: FILES WRITTEN IN PROJECT (0), SHELL COMMANDS RUN (0); only tool call is glob {"pattern": "**/*"}; no install commands and nothing written outside the workspace
